scope.selectedMinimum: Register and implement one AT-workflows-1 static CLI case using the existing EngineeringControl.checkResearch owner and component-comparison probe pattern.

atWorkflows1.required: A choice missing compared alternatives, primary evidence, reliability/resource tradeoffs, or validation criteria is blocked by the pre-build gate with missing evidence and a named register entry; isolated candidate_write research with read-only inputs and bounded report export remains possible.

atWorkflows2.required: For an uncertain effect with an official API, proven protected browser option, and unreviewed script, route research selects a supported least-fragile adequate route, cites current primary evidence, and never treats denial as permission for another route.

baseline.result: Both registered CLI invocations returned NOT_IMPLEMENTED / REGISTERED_CASE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, sourceRegistration:null, and no exact case result. The disposable world shut down successfully with zero unresolved references.
baseline.interpretation: This proves the missing CLI registration/case path only; it did not test or falsify checkResearch behavior.

publicOwnerAndContracts.owner: EngineeringControl.checkResearch(input: MapCheckInputV1, context: OpsControlContextV1, testDocuments: ResearchDocumentOverlayV1[] = [])
publicOwnerAndContracts.publicInput: Generated MapCheckInputV1 and OpsControlContextV1; existing bounded ResearchDocumentOverlayV1 seam can supply the incomplete M11 comparison fixture.

publicOwnerAndContracts.reuse: Keep checkResearch as sole decision owner. Assert its output using one incomplete M11-linked comparison overlay. sourceCard.title: Register M11 incomplete-comparison workflow gate at the CLI rung
sourceCard.expectedEffort: Approximately two hours, excluding unrelated generator or environment failure
sourceCard.change: Add one truthful AT-workflows-1 static CLI manifest case and dispatch it through the existing component-comparison probe. Target the named M11 register/report material with one incomplete ResearchComponentComparisonV2 record: one option only, no primary evidence, no reliability/maintenance/resource tradeoff evidence, and no valid validation plan. Reuse generated contracts and the current owner. Update feature-map facts via the established generation path.
exactCases: The public inspection identifies the exact M11 register row/component decision and report/archive binding; overall admission BLOCKED alone does not pass.
The M11 decision is BLOCKED with the missing cells REQUIRED_OPTIONS_MISSING, PRIMARY_EVIDENCE_MISSING, TRADEOFFS_MISSING, and VALIDATION_PLAN_MISSING.
The probe result names M11 and the missing-evidence identifiers; persisted probe.show returns the same case result and archive binding.
Only the static gate scenario passes; neither complete AT-workflows-1 nor AT-workflows-2 is claimed complete.
prohibit: A second research validator or generic research/report infrastructure.
Hand-copied DTOs or manual edits to generated registry artifacts.
Synthetic flags or fixture prose claiming route adequacy, permission, denial semantics, or protected/authenticated proof.

currentGap.missing: The workflow AT IDs are present in generated CLI acceptance inventory, but the registered CLI manifest has no source registration for either. Baseline reaches only the generic not-implemented path.
currentGap.ownerBehavior: Not yet observed for the M11 workflow fixture. Existing checkResearch capability does not itself establish these workflow-specific cells.
